c40: What if your delivery methodology didn't live in documents, but ran inside the work?
One repository everyone reads, with nCino's own knowledge through the Admin MCP at every step.
Agents draft. People decide, at discovery and again at code.
Morning in Wellington: a feature page becomes stories and tasks, with two questions raised and two owners named.
Afternoon in Manila: a developer picks it up, the gates hold, the change deploys.
One month in: three times the tickets completed each sprint, with stories the same size.
Every bug fixed in the sprint it was raised. A model trained in nine weeks, packaged for the next squad.
Grounded in nCino. Decided by people. Delivered by Accenture.
